newsitem.title: USA: Famous Dave's to open 8 restaurants in '97.
newsitem.headline: Famous Dave's to open 8 restaurants in '97.

text.p: Famous Dave's of America Inc, which currently operates three roadhouse-style barbecue restaurants, said Tuesday it plans to add eight restaurants in 1997 and 15 to 20 in 1998.

Expansion plans will be financed initially by the $15 million in funds generated from the company's initial public offering last October, said Mark Payne, chief financial officer, in a telephone interview.
Earlier today, Famous Dave's reported net sales of about $4.8 million for its fiscal year ended December 29, 1996. This compares with sales of $481,510 generated in fiscal 1995.
The Minneapolis-based company reported a net loss for its 1996 fiscal year of $706,598 or $0.21 a share compared with a net loss of $306,190 or $0.14 for 1995.
Profits were reduced by increased general, administrative and development expenses as the company gears up for substantial expansion, the company said in a statement.

Famous Dave's develops, owns and operates roadhouse-style barbecue restaurants under the name Famous Dave's BBQ Shack. A larger unit, called Famous Dave's BBQ and Blues, offers live blues music. The company currently operates two Famous Dave's BBQ Shacks and one Famous Dave's BBQ and Blues.

For the 1996 year, the BBQ Shacks units reported a restaurant operating margin of 21 percent, while the BBQ and Blues unit had a restaurant operating margin of over 17 percent in its first full quarter of operation, it said.

Famous Dave's said it completed purchase of a fifth location in Stillwater, Minn., and will begin construction of a BBQ Shack on that site in the first quarter. Construction of the BBQ Shack in Maple Grove, a fourth location, is on schedule for an April opening, Payne said.
